rows.note: Use this as the direct equivalent when something is required.

example.english: A passport is an essential document for applying for a visa.
example.traditional: 護照係申請簽證嘅必要文件。
example.jyutping: wu6 ziu3 hai6 san1 cing2 cim1 zing3 ge3 bit1 jiu3 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this when “essential” means highly important rather than required.

example.english: Handing in your homework on time is essential, or you will lose marks.
example.traditional: 準時交功課好重要，唔係就會扣分。
example.jyutping: zeon2 si4 gaau1 gung1 fo3 hou2 zung6 jiu3 m4 hai6 zau6 wui5 kau3 fan1

rows.note: Use this colloquial construction to say that A is simply the way A typically is.

example.english: He is just like that; forgetfulness is essential to who he is.
example.traditional: 佢個人就係咁㗎啦，成日都唔記得帶鎖匙。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 jan4 zau6 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1 sing4 jat6 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4
